description: Plugin-level hooks. pave-init: a skill-frontmatter hook fires only for the agent that invoked the skill, so the planning-layout warning (node planners write planning/), the write-for-the-reader reminder, and the goal restatement (SessionStart resume|compact for the lead, SubagentStart for every seat) register here. All are armed by the .pave-init-run marker and stay silent outside an active run. The stop check and the staleness reminder are lead-only and stay in the skill's frontmatter. orchestrate: the goal restate (SessionStart resume|compact) and the speed-up question (PostToolUse Bash after a run-log write, which also asks the lead to stop agents it no longer needs) register here because skill-frontmatter SessionStart hooks never run and frontmatter hooks do not survive a resume. These two lead hooks act only for the session that owns an open orchestrate run, found through its marker in ~/.orchestrate/. maintainer_nudge (PostToolUse after a file edit) reminds orchestrate workers, at most once a minute, of the maintainer bar in their instructions, keyed on the agent type, and it never blocks.
